exact_statement: Retain A062-B05-MINIMAL-RESERVE-CREDIT@5 at its original scoped hypotheses (source-pinned). Append: For every real C>=6 and even k>=2, take the canonical quadratic bent k-bit core b, its zero-vertex flip v, independent majority3 seed a and fair tag w. With A=(b+v)/2, B=(b-v)/2, M=A+wB, F=A+w*a*B and t=2^-k, increasing data-pair-then-tag profile completion and increasing seed completion have Q_C(M)=Q_C(a)=0. The tree beginning with tag then all seed bits has full-terminal stopped debt epsilon=D_w(M)+2t-(5/2)Ct > t(k-(5/2)C), so any complete extension has Q_C(F)>=epsilon. Hence the same zero inherited graft bank fails at every fixed C>=6 for sufficiently large even k; the hidden-tag theorem survives. For every finite L disjoint modules debts add; L=2^k gives debt>k-(5/2)C. This is a prescribed-policy obstruction, not an unbounded H/I family.
